cohort: Placental samples were obtained postpartum from 101 pregnancies with IUGR and 140 normal pregnancies.
finding: There was no significant difference in PIGF gene activity between IUGR versus normal pregnancy groups, but placental PIGF gene activity was significantly lower in fetuses with more severe IUGR compared to less severe cases.
cross-section timing: Postpartum samples collected during the calendar year of 2012.
